project_info.theme: Playful luxury fashion cover surrounded by paparazzi cameras
project_info.color_palette: beige-white dress, warm skin, black camera bodies, silver jewelry and clean editorial white

main_subject.detail: Clearly adult woman whose facial identity is preserved from the approved uploaded face reference. She has light-brown hair in a low neat updo with loose strands, natural glowing makeup, glossy pink lips and soft blush. She winks with her left eye, makes a playful pursed-lip expression and raises both hands near her face to form a heart gesture. She wears a minimalist beige-white strapless evening dress with a silver designer-style necklace and diamond ring.
main_subject.style: realistic high-fashion editorial portrait with natural skin texture and professional studio finish

composition_elements.background: photographers holding DSLR cameras and smartphones, with some screens showing the subject's live image
composition_elements.text: Use the source's Vogue-style magazine layout and supplied visible masthead hierarchy; keep any logo treatment consistent with the approved source reference.

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: cinematic professional studio/event lighting with soft HDR-like background separation and camera flashes
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: playful luxurious fashion atmosphere, crisp face, realistic camera reflections and smooth bokeh

technical_specs.optics: 85mm lens feel, f/1.8 aperture, crisp face and smooth background bokeh

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a realistic high-fashion magazine-cover-style portrait using the uploaded approved adult face reference as the original face reference, preserving facial identity, eyes, nose and mouth. A clearly adult elegant woman poses confidently, winking with her left eye and making a playful pursed-lip expression. Both hands are raised near her face, forming a love or heart gesture. She is surrounded by multiple DSLR cameras and smartphones held around her as paparazzi and photographers capture her from all directions; some phones show her live image on their screens. She has glowing natural skin, natural makeup, glossy pink lips, soft blush and light-brown hair in a low neat updo with a few loose strands. She wears an elegant minimalist beige-white strapless evening dress, a silver designer-style necklace and a diamond ring. Use a close-up to half-body fashion portrait, Vogue-style editorial cover framing, cinematic professional lighting, realistic skin texture, ultra-detailed 8K quality, an 85mm lens feel at f/1.8, crisp focus and smooth bokeh. Preserve the approved adult identity, playful heart gesture, camera crowd and luxury cover composition without adding a celebrity likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, unauthorized identity change, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, duplicate cameras, distorted phone screens, misspelled text
